newsitem.title: USA: Eddie Bauer to expand into Britain.
newsitem.headline: Eddie Bauer to expand into Britain.

text.p: Eddie Bauer, the outdoor apparel company known for its rugged American styles, will open stores in Britain in a joint venture, its owner Spiegel Inc. said Friday.
The joint venture, being formed with Grattan Plc, part of Otto Versand Group, plans to open three stores in Britain beginning in late 1997, Spiegel said.
Eddie Bauer UK plans to also launch catalogue distribution with one catalogue in 1997, three in 1998 and four in 1999, Eddie Bauer said.
Eddie Bauer already has stores in Japan and Germany, aside from North America.
"We've found that the Eddie Bauer merchandise, style and format translate beautifully internationally," said Rick Fersch, Eddie Bauer president.
